*
* Title: OEICUSTM
* Author: Anthony G. White
* Date Written: 06-04-94
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0
* Revision History:
* Mod. By Date Vers Description of Changes
* -------------------------------------------------------------
* A. White 05-23-94 1.0 Initial Version, borrowed most of this
* screen from oeienter.
* M. Hoang 08-01-94 1.1 referenced contact block from srvlib
* M. Hoang 08-04-94 1.2 referenced avail_products, avail_tiers
* blocks from srvlib
* M. Hoang 08-10-94 1.3 fixed stranged message in ordered_by
* M. Hoang 08-11-94 1.4 get sub flag from vserv_contracts
* M. Hoang 08-15-94 1.5 fixed antigens block
* M. Hoang 08-16-94 1.6 fixed canceling order logic
* M. Hoang 08-19-94 1.7 fixed long contact validation, line
* commit problem
* M. Hoang 08-23-94 1.8 referenced customer_id,
* populate order_patients table
* M. Hoang 08-25-94 1.9 fixed inventory_levels access
* M. Hoang 08-26-94 1.10 fixed a navigation problem
* M. Hoang 08-31-94 1.11 added change capability
* M. Hoang 09-01-94 1.12 fixed query and navigation problems
* M. Hoang 09-20-94 1.17 retrieved doctor and patient names
*
* Abstract:
* This form allows an operator to enter an order for blood products
* into the Serve*Care system. Customers normally CALL_FORM in from affiliated
* hospitals to place orders. These order must contain at least one
* attribute or antigen.
*
* Menu Reference:
* Error Conditions:
* 0200 -- invalid function key
* 0201 -- all required fields must be entered
* 0202 -- duplicate sort sequence
* 0300 -- invalid blood type
* 0302 -- invalid customer
* 0303 -- invalid contact
* 0304 -- invalid contact
* 0305 -- invalid attribute code
* 0309 -- invalid product code
* 0600 -- unsuccessful commit
* 1200 -- orderer name must be entered
* 1208 -- All numbers must be entered
* 1300 -- invalid consignee ID
* 1301 -- invalid payee ID
* 1302 -- Customer ID already exists */
* 1304 -- invalid tier
* 1704 -- order has not been completed
* 1705 -- invalid order type
* 1706 -- invalid order class
* 1707 -- invalid quantity
* 1708 -- no standing orders set up
* Inputs:
* Outputs:
* Modules Referenced:
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This form allows order entry for user at a blood bank taking orders
* over the telephone. It is not intended for querying, updating or
* deleting orders. It contains 2 major blocks and 7 minor blocks. The 2
* major blocks are:
* - orders: this block contains all info related to an order, the
* associated database table is orders. Customer info and order summary
* are maintained in this block.
* - items: this block contains infos related to order line items, the
* associated table is order_items. Line item product code, blood type
* outdate range and unit price are in this block.
* The 7 minor blocks are
* - contact: this block allows quick entry of a new contact to be added
* to database, it is based on contact table.
* - consignee: user can update or add a ship to customer to the order
* and to customer table. For new customer, user has to create a new
* customer id.
* - attributes: Attributes for special order line items
* - antigens: Antigens for special order line items
* - item_attr: info for custom order such as pooling and splitting source
* are in this block, base table is order_item_attributes
* - open_orders: displays the open orders for the customer ID
* - answer: confirm block for backing out of an order
*
************************************************************************

procedure parse_abo_local (scan_abo in VARCHAR2,
 vabo_code out VARCHAR2, vabo out VARCHAR2) is
-- this procedure allows user to enter blood type in free style
 temp_entry varchar2(20);
 temp_v_code_scheme varchar2(1); 
 temp_v_chapter varchar2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 pl_abo_desc varchar2(50);
BEGIN

 nullchk;
 default_value(NULL,'global.code_scheme');
 temp_v_code_scheme := name_in('GLOBAL.code_scheme');

 IF temp_v_code_scheme is null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT decode(sign(sysdate - nvl(isbt_start_date,sysdate+1)),
 1,'I','C')
 INTO temp_v_code_scheme 
 FROM chapters
 WHERE chapter_id = temp_v_chapter; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF; 


 if upper(scan_abo) != 'M'
 then
 IF name_in('global.code_scheme') = 'I' THEN
 temp_entry :=upper(substr(scan_abo,3,2)); 
 ELSE --If Coding Scheme is Codabar
 temp_entry := upper(substr(scan_abo,2,2));
 END IF;
 else
 temp_entry := upper(name_in('system.cursor_value'));
 pl_abo_desc:=:items.s_abo_desc;
 end if;
 -- first try to match code or full description

 Begin
 --Modified for both the schemes
 select distinct (abo_code), abo_desc
 into vabo_code, vabo
 from vserv_abo
 where ( upper(abo_code) = temp_entry
 or (
 (upper(abo_desc) like upper(temp_entry||'%')
 and temp_v_code_scheme = 'C')
 or (upper(abo_desc) = upper(temp_entry)
 and temp_v_code_scheme = 'I')
 )
 ) 
 AND unit_scheme_type = temp_v_code_scheme
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 -- if found it, return
 return;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 message('2');
 handle_error;
 End;

 -- last try, match a free style entry (e.g. 'a-')

 temp_entry := replace(temp_entry,' ','');

 
 Begin
 --Select abo is modified to Select distinct (abo)
 select distinct (abo_code), abo_desc
 into vabo_code, vabo
 from vserv_abo
 where ((upper(temp_entry) like upper(abo_entry_1|| '%')) or (upper(temp_entry) like upper(abo_entry_2||'%')))
 and ( upper (abo_desc) like upper(pl_abo_desc) || '%' or upper(pl_abo_desc) like upper(abo_desc)||'%')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 Exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('0300'); /* invalid blood type */
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 -- message('2A'); 
 handle_error;
 End;

EXCEPTION
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 show_error_dist('0604'); -- inconsistent data
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
END;

procedure select_cust_with_contract
 (entry in VARCHAR2, include in VARCHAR2, cust_id out VARCHAR2) is
 --
 -- this procedure allows user to select customer by entering a few
 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search
 -- include : customer_types to be included
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 inlist VARCHAR2(100);
 chap_id varchar2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 cursor c1 is select code
 from vserv_customer_type where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) 
 union 
 select code
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'DCUST' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) 
 order by 1;
begin
 --
 -- set up list of customer types to be included
 if include is null
 then
 for c1rec in c1
 loop
 inlist :=inlist||c1rec.code||',';
 --next_record;
 end loop;
 inlist :=''''||rtrim(inlist,',')||'''';
 -- inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,PA,RD,RG'; -- all customer types
 else
 inlist := include;
 end if;
 --
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = entry
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where upper(name) like entry || '%'
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 -- cust_id := '';
 --list_values;
 cust_id := null;
 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers, Contracts');
 check_package_failure;
end;

key hit will bring up any open order items associated with this customer
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :system.cursor_value is not null
 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :orders.customer_id is not null
 and :orders.contract_id is not null
 then

 from order_items
 where order_no in (select o.order_no
 from orders o
 where o.customer_id = :orders.customer_id
 and o.order_type = 'SP'

 get_attributes(:open_order.invisible_order_no);
 else

 /*1210 - Customer ID and contract ID must be filled in */

 end if;

 then

end;
